title: MAP_LAND_LEVEL constant is dead after the edge-bias rework
evidence:
MAP_LAND_LEVEL   :: 0.38 // the pre-ring land threshold (kept as the reference base)
...
			lvl: f32 = MAP_INTERIOR_LEVEL + MAP_EDGE_BIAS * edge_bias_factor(x, y, w, h)
			if value_noise(seed, x, y, MAP_LAND_CELL_PX) < lvl {
detail: Repo-wide search finds only the declaration; pass 1 now thresholds on MAP_INTERIOR_LEVEL + edge bias. A dead tuning constant invites confusion about which level governs land.
recommended_fix: Delete MAP_LAND_LEVEL; its tuning history is already captured in the v2-scale-depth comment block above the constants.

title: tier_pipe_width comment claims a ratio the new values do not keep
detail: 4.5:7.4:10.5 is 1:1.64:2.33, not 1:1.57:2.43 (the old ladder's ratio); capping wide necessarily breaks it. A future retune derived from the stated ratio starts wrong.
recommended_fix: Reword the comment to the actual ratios (1:1.64:2.33) and state that wide is deliberately capped below the house footprint.

title: Positional Shadow_Spec literals allow silent rx/ry transposition
detail: rx and ry are both f32, so swapped fractions compile cleanly and silently skew shadows. Named literals would self-document each tuning value at the use site.
recommended_fix: Use named struct literals ({rx = 0.60, ry = 0.35, ink = 36}) in shadow_for_role and shadow_for_puck.
